chapter: Freelance and studio work in New York
title: Swing Era neglect and Glenn Miller's remark about Bix
summary: In the studios during the swing years, Miller asked for arrangements, never used them, and remarked that they were Bix-like.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: How did the resurgence of the bands, in the Swing Era, affect you.
I'm an old man for them by this time. I'm in the studio. And they don't particularly want any part of me, I imagine.
You stayed in the studio until '39, right.

I would say so, yeah. At different places and different times. I worked here and there, and the work was getting spotty, although there was a time around there that Glenn Miller, I think, was coming up. He wanted me to do a couple of arrangements.
Did he ask you to do some specific things?
No, He never used them, but I think they come out somehow or other.
What was the remark you heard later, he made, that came back to you.
I asked him, I said, hey, I called him, you know, 'How about those arrangements?' I wanted to get

some more to do. His band was coming along good, so he said, "We're going to record, why don't you come down?" I went down and he played the thing over and it didn't sound too bad to me, but it wasn't a Glenn Miller type arrangement, evidently.

So anyway, it wasn't that that bothered him. He played the arrangement over and he says, "This is built a lot on Bix's stuff, isn't it, Bix type," you know, so I -- what could I say, "Yeah," and he said, what the hell -- it wasn't any more Bix than I was, but if he wanted to figure it that way, let him figure it.

So anyway, well, he said, "These kids never even heard of him. They don't know anything about Bix." So okay, and you know, I didn't want to force myself on anybody. I know what it was, the first year of my marriage, I wanted to get some work.

I was married that year, because I remember calling. I lived up in 57th Street. I called -- I think that could have been the reason why I called -- I called him to get a check. Anyway it didn't make that much difference. I mean if I was going to do some work I wanted to do it on my own and there was plenty around in the studios.
So I don't know, but there was a lot of this stuff well, it was free-lancing, it was hit or miss, do it there or here. Half of it I don't remember. Then actually -- and then
